series.name: US housing permits
series.units: Thousands of units, seasonally adjusted annual rate

series.name: US manufacturing output
series.units: Seasonally adjusted index; base varies by vintage
series.role: Coincident activity confirmation; within-vintage growth only

series.name: US manufacturing weekly hours
series.units: Hours, production and nonsupervisory employees, seasonally adjusted

series.name: US temporary help employment
series.role: Leading labor demand candidate; structural changes can weaken the relationship

series.name: US core capital goods new orders
series.role: Leading investment demand; excludes defense and aircraft; nominal, not inflation-adjusted

series.name: Philadelphia Fed future new orders
series.role: Leading six-month expectations; regional manufacturing survey, not national PMI

series.name: Philadelphia Fed future employment
series.role: Leading six-month hiring intentions; regional manufacturing survey, not national PMI

series.name: US nonfarm payroll employment
series.role: Coincident labor confirmation; monthly changes and revisions, not a leading indicator

series.name: US headline consumer prices
series.role: Lagging inflation / policy context; growth within vintage, not a leading activity indicator

series.name: US core consumer prices
series.role: Lagging inflation / policy context, excluding food and energy

series.name: US Treasury 10-year minus 3-month yield
series.role: Yield-curve slope; financial leading candidate, not a recession probability

series.name: US Treasury 10-year minus 2-year yield
series.role: Yield-curve slope; nominal rates with different maturities

series.name: Chicago Fed credit conditions
series.role: Credit-conditions composite; positive means tighter than average; revised standardized index, not a corporate bond spread

series.name: US bank lending standards: large and medium firms
series.units: Net percentage tightening, not seasonally adjusted
series.role: SLOOS credit supply; positive is tightening, negative easing; quarter date is not publication date

series.name: US bank lending standards: small firms
series.units: Net percentage tightening, not seasonally adjusted
series.role: SLOOS credit supply; preserve release-vintage availability, never use quarter start as release date

source_gaps.name: National manufacturing and services PMI
source_gaps.status: Source access and archive verification pending
source_gaps.detail: ISM series were removed from FRED in 2016. ISM archival use requires appropriate permission; S&P Global offers subscribed PMI histories. Obtain a permitted feed with original releases, subcomponents and timestamps before historical use. Regional Fed surveys are separate inputs.

source_gaps.name: Corporate credit spreads
source_gaps.status: Source rights and archive qualification pending
source_gaps.detail: Treasury yield curves, Chicago Fed credit conditions and SLOOS recorders are admitted. NFCICREDIT is a composite, not a corporate spread. The BAA10Y source notes restrict reproduction and storage; qualify a permitted source separately before capture.

source_gaps.name: Release-time consensus and economic surprises
source_gaps.detail: Do not call a month-on-month change a surprise. Record forecasts timestamped before release, first print, revisions and market expectations separately.

source_gaps.name: Country and sector fundamentals
source_gaps.detail: Country PMI/orders and inflation, EIA energy balances and CFTC positioning need local publication timestamps and separate vintage audits; US data alone are not country coverage.
